title: 2026 Essex municipal parcel records matched; fab geography remains unresolved
summary: The Town of Essex and City of Essex Junction grand lists match two earlier parcel IDs and SPANs. Their April 1, 2026 owner-name period and distinct municipal identities remain explicit despite matching E911 fields. No fab footprint or current ownership is established.
evidence_note: The official index and two unmodified 2026 workbooks are pinned. Exact Sheet1 rows 1598 and 1225, headers and literal values were checked; complete header/row renders were visually inspected. The projection excludes attention contacts and financial fields, preserves the underlying tax-map strings and does not overwrite the earlier state-query years or missing fields.
publication_effect: Additive context on four exact related readings, their hub cards and the existing geographic export. Earlier notes, both prior follow-ups, historical records and accepted entity counts remain unchanged. No boundary determination, independent acceptance, deployment or launch.
